notes: Implemented a secret-safe 40-case synthetic RAG quality evaluator and executed a real-provider staging health check plus a 12-case bounded trial. M5/M7 gates remain open for full-suite repeatability, representative-corpus review, human error review, provider revision, usage/cost, fallback, and breaker evidence.
